[Marks: 4×1.5=6] Answer briefly.
(a) Does sorting the array improve the worst-case running time of linear search?
(b) Why is binary search not efficient on a linked list?
(c) What is the maximum number of iterations ternary search needs on a sorted array of 1,000 elements?
(d) Is O(log3 n) a different complexity class from O(log2 n)? Justify your answer.
2.
[Marks: 4+2=6] The function below computes np mod m.
1MODPOW(n, p, m) 2 r = 1 3 b = n mod m 4 while p > 0 5 if p mod 2 == 1 6 r = (r × b) mod m 7 b = (b × b) mod m 8 p = ⌊p / 2⌋ 9 return r
(a) How many times does the while loop run for MODPOW(3, 35324, 99999983)? Show how you got your answer.
(b) What is the time complexity of MODPOW in terms of p? Justify briefly.
3.
[Marks: 8] A sorted list A[0..n−1] holds names in lowercase English letters, and no two names start with the same character. Write pseudocode for a function FIND(A, n, c) that returns the index of the name starting with the character c, or −1 if there is no such name.
Example:
anik0babu1dipu2faria3joy4mitu5rafi6tania7
FIND(A, 8, 'm') returns 5 (mitu)FIND(A, 8, 'k') returns −1
